levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «رفعه إلى» is the gap before Sadiq, kept as an unnamed link in its place.
Sadiq is written inside the chain after «إلى»: narrator. The saying is Zayn al-Abidin's words, named only after the chain: imam_in_text, last link.
The two men named Muhammad b. al-Hasan are two links, each with its own «حدثني».
